title: turnkey
description: Turnkey pairing + session-binding + audio-state DTOs (schema v1, turnkey contributor owns). Normative companion to docs/TURNKEY-CONTRACT.md. All tokens/pins/secrets are redacted in fixtures (shape only, no values). Error/code strings are stable contracts; unknown future codes must be surfaced, never silently defaulted.

pairingState.description: Authoritative watch pairing state. failed-closed persists until the user restarts pairing; enrolled means a per-device token is stored alongside a pinned cert.

certPin.description: DER SHA-256 base64 of exactly 32 bytes, sha256/ prefix. Compared constant-time. Never logged.

full.description: Full SHA-256 fingerprint, lowercase colon-hex, always one tap away.

short.description: Minimum 96-bit / 6 groups of 4 hex for side-by-side compare. A 6-digit code MUST NOT be used here.

pairInfo.description: GET /pair/info response: CERT ONLY. Served without auth, carries no user content, no token, no secret.

enrollmentSecret.description: >=128-bit client CSPRNG, base64url, single-use, sent ONLY over pinned TLS after fingerprint trust.

enrollmentRequest.description: POST /pair/enroll body. Rejected unless the caller presents the pinned cert channel.

pendingApproval.description: Server pending-request view (trusted authenticated Mac Settings UI only). Pending TTL max 120000ms; max pending entries and per-IP rate bound enforced server-side.

tokenDelivery.description: Token METADATA envelope only (insufficient for delivery). The token BYTES are field `token` in pollApproved only; this object never carries the bytes.

requestId.description: Opaque unguessable pending-request id (>=128-bit CSPRNG, base64url). Sensitive: never logged. No auth-query lookup.

enrollResponse.description: POST /pair/enroll 201 response. expiresAtMs - enrolledAtMs <= 120000. Synthetic fixtures only.

pollRequest.description: POST /pair/poll body. Constant-time secret compare. Sensitive: never logged.

pollApproved.description: POST /pair/poll 200 approved response. Field `token` carries the token BYTES (sensitive: never logged, header-only thereafter, one-use requestId consumed on delivery). baseUrl is the immutable captured origin echo.

denyRequest.description: POST /pair/deny body (DSH-admin only). No secret accepted.

adminStatus.description: DSH-admin settings status (requestRejection-gated). Fingerprint/host-candidates/port/backend-status plus identifier-only pending rows.

pairApproval.description: POST /admin/pair/approval body. fingerprintConfirmed MUST be true (Mac-side compare proof). No enrollmentSecret accepted.

micStartRequest.description: POST /watch/mic/start body. streamId is a non-secret correlator, never auth.

micStartOk.description: POST /watch/mic/start 200 ready response. Else 503 mic-not-ready actionable.

deviceBinding.description: GET /watch/binding row: the session the device currently means. autoFollow true clears any pin.

audioStreamState.description: Per-stream audio readiness/capture state. No silent transitions: every entry to error/closed-carries a receipt.

delivered.description: True only after genuine host prompt admission; never true for question dictation.

drafted.description: True only after a validated current-question draft was stored. Never a host prompt or host acknowledgement.

audioReceipt.description: Terminal/per-window accounting, never PCM or transcript text. A closed terminal receipt must prove host admission or a real current-question draft. No-speech and delivery failures are errors, not successful closure. Error receipts require code/message/retryable. Legacy receipt compatibility is outside this managed contract.

queueReorder.description: False on SDK rc.1, which cannot reorder. Legacy absence keeps prior UI behavior.

openMac.description: True only when the actual SDK native opener is available. Legacy absence keeps prior UI behavior.

micCancel.description: Input-only force-cancel support. Legacy absence means unsupported; never substitute agent or voice-session cancel.

features.description: Additive capability flags advertised on hello, snapshot, state, health and capabilities.

micCancelRequest.description: Authenticated POST /watch/command. Force-cancels only the device-owned pending or ready native input. Normal record-off closes the PCM body and drains its receipt instead. Never cancels an SDK turn, TTS, follow or voice session.

micCancelResponse.description: True only if an owned pending/ready input existed. Missing or already closed is idempotent false. Foreign existing inputs return 403, malformed IDs 400. Cancellation intents are bounded and prevent late preflight allocation or ready acknowledgement.

errorEnvelope.description: Stable failure shape. Known error codes: WATCH_SESSION_UNCONFIGURED, not the watch session, mic-delivery-failed, trust-mismatch, approval-required|denied|expired, rate-limited, pair-probe-liveness-only. Unknown codes surface verbatim.
